concerns.location: plan.md:Section 'Implementation Phases & FR/SC Mapping' (Phase 3 – MMN Quantification & Core Analyses)
concerns.text: The plan does not provide a power analysis or justification for the expected sample size (≈20 subjects, up to 20 % exclusions). Without an a priori power calculation, it is unclear whether the study is sufficiently powered to detect the targeted medium effect (Cohen’s d ≥ 0.5). This threatens the ability to draw reliable conclusions about the hypothesis that MMN scales with scene complexity.

Potential confounds are not addressed: the number of trials per condition may differ, stimulus order (simple vs. complex) is not counterbalanced, and subject‑level covariates (e.g., age, gender, hearing ability) are ignored. These factors could bias the paired t‑test results and undermine causal interpretation of the complexity effect.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 3 – step 3.5 & 3.6 (canonical topography generation and consistency/validity checks)
concerns.text: The canonical topography template is derived from the same ‘simple’ condition that is later used for the consistency check. This circularity can inflate the apparent topographic similarity (Pearson r ≥ 0.8) and may mask systematic differences between conditions. A truly independent template (e.g., from an external dataset or a leave‑one‑subject‑out approach) should be used to avoid bias.
